$comment: Lint debt ratchet baseline. NOT a config file — a measurement, committed so that
its version history IS the metric's trajectory.
PREDICATE (what was counted, over which population, matched how):
ESLint warning-severity findings, grouped by rule id, produced by the flat
config in eslint.config.mjs over the whole repository minus that config's
`ignores` block, using the rule set pinned by eslint-config-next@16.3.3.
Error-severity findings are NOT in this file: the ratchet holds them at zero
unconditionally.
COUNTER (the exact command that recomputes every number below):
npm run lint:ratchet
RULES OF THE RATCHET (see registry quality-gates/ratchet-design):
- Any mismatch fails, in EITHER direction. A drop is actionable divergence,
not silent good news — it can also mean the matcher broke or the file was
deleted, and those three produce a byte-identical baseline diff.
- Re-baselining is a human diff. The commit message must NAME THE CAUSE.
- Never auto-update. A pipeline that rewrites this file has turned the gate
into a recorder.
- GRADUATION: when a bucket reaches 0, delete its entry here AND its
downgrade in eslint.config.mjs, so the rule stands at plain blocking
severity.
